doc: JSON1 scalar functions. Twelve new variants of ScalarKind (declared in parts/vdbe/parts/opcodes-expr/shapes.json). This shapes.json carries the supporting types for the json1 module: an internal JsonNode model, a JsonError condition set, and the JsonPathSegment grammar. Targets emit these as idiomatic-language equivalents (Rust enum, C tagged union, Zig union(enum), Go interface, Python class).

JsonNode.doc: Internal JSON model. Number splits into Integer/Real to match SQL value flow; Object preserves insertion order in the underlying list.

JsonObjectEntry.doc: Object key+value, ordered by insertion. Targets render as a (key, value) pair; when serializing, iterate in list order.

JsonPathSegment.doc: One step of a parsed JSONPath. The full path is a list of these starting from the root '$'.

JsonError.doc: Closed set of JSON1-internal error conditions. v1 collapses every variant to SQL Null at the runtime boundary. A follow-up promotes these to RuntimeCondition.
